releases.title: Alkebuleum Opens Its Founding Council to Reputable Institutions Across Africa and the Diaspora
releases.summary: The Alkebuleum Foundation opens its Founding Council — the institutional governance body of Africa's sovereign trust infrastructure — to reputable institutions across the continent and diaspora. The network, which began operations in Liberia in 2025, now invites governments, banks, universities, and diaspora organizations to join its founding governance body.
